verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS design platform like Canva, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Canva publishing its source code or any license. The OpenAPI description, Apps SDK and CLI are developer building blocks and API specs, not open-source product code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
